name: Bousou Teacher Shiho ~Ai no Kanchou Kyouiku~
original_name: 暴走ティーチャー志帆 ～愛の浣腸教育～
source:
The teacher, fervent about correction, resorts to drastic measures to deal with the unruly and uncontrollable girl.

That is――the teacher's hobby, SM play. Among other things, she uses the particularly humiliating "enema play" to reform the delinquent girl.

Thus begins an unconventional educational assistance!..

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx/work/=/product_id/VJ012987.html/]dlsite[/url]]
